strings: r_c0 notices with some concern that any time m_c opens {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyes, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/mewl/mewls} incessantly and {VERB/m_c/try/tries} to wriggle into the darkest corners of the medicine cat den. r_c0 suspects {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} may have chronic headaches.

Rather than go outside in the bright sunlight to play with {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} littermates, m_c prefers to huddle by {PRONOUN/m_c/self} in the dark and quiet of the medicine cat den, {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head hurting too much to move.
